title.en: Fable 17 — The Dog and His Reflection

sentences.en: A dog was carrying meat in his mouth.
He passed over a bridge above the water.
He saw his reflection in the water.

sentences.ar: حسب إنه كلب تاني معه لحمة.
sentences.en: He thought it was another dog with meat.
He opened his mouth to bark at him.
The meat fell and was lost.

sentences.ar: اللي بده كل إشي بيخسر اللي معه.
sentences.en: Whoever wants everything loses what he has.
